title: Causal MODFLOW head-tolerance compatibility at the G23 stiff-groundwater residual floors
question: Are the two G23 GW_MIXED endpoint failures caused by the fixed STANDARD MODFLOW head-convergence scale being coarser than the head correction required to satisfy the independently frozen 1e-15 m/s external interface residual criterion?

frozen_algorithm.publication: same nominal SWAP+ledger handoff only after physical convergence

preregistered_prediction.derivation: For local external residual F=q_swap-q_gw with slopes p=dq_swap/dH<0 and a=dq_gw/dH>0, the first-order head correction scale is |F|/|p-a|. G23 gives approximately 5.25e-14 m for C0_MIXED_POS and 2.79e-13 m for C3_MIXED_NEG.
preregistered_prediction.c3_mixed_neg: STANDARD should reproduce failure; TIGHT_1 should be fine enough to permit the required correction and should physically converge.
preregistered_prediction.c0_mixed_pos: STANDARD should reproduce failure; TIGHT_1 may remain below resolution because 5.25e-14 < 1e-13; TIGHT_2 should permit the required correction and should physically converge.
preregistered_prediction.matched_controls: C0_MIXED_NEG and C3_MIXED_POS should remain physically qualified at every tolerance level.
preregistered_prediction.note: These are falsifiable predictions, not acceptance retuning. G23 stays partial even if all predictions are met.

execution_contract: Run all 12 case-by-tolerance combinations from fresh SWAP and MODFLOW initialization.
Change only MODFLOW outer_dvclose and inner_dvclose according to the frozen ladder; preserve all other G23 model, solver, coupling, tangent, globalization and transaction settings.
Record NONMETH and require 3 for every arm.
Record every accepted head, external residual, response status, MODFLOW response solve-call count and prepared-response minus independent-oracle diagnostic.
For every arm classify physical convergence only by the unchanged G23 external residual and independent head criteria.
For every physically converged arm perform the same final ordinary-candidate reacquisition and nominal SWAP+ledger handoff.
Do not change the external residual gate, outer budget, tangent scales, merit rule or start heads after observing results.

decision_rules.STRONG_DVCLOSE_CAUSAL_SUPPORT: STANDARD reproduces both G23 failures; C3_MIXED_NEG passes at TIGHT_1; C0_MIXED_POS remains failed at TIGHT_1 but passes at TIGHT_2; both matched controls pass all three tolerance levels; all converged handoffs pass.
decision_rules.DVCLOSE_CAUSAL_SUPPORT_DIFFERENT_THRESHO: STANDARD reproduces both failures and both failures pass by TIGHT_2, but the exact predicted transition ordering differs; matched controls and handoffs remain qualified.
decision_rules.DVCLOSE_NOT_SUFFICIENT: At least one G23 failure remains physically unqualified at TIGHT_2 under unchanged budgets and coupling rules.
decision_rules.MIXED_OR_UNRESOLVED: Baseline reproduction, matched-control or transaction/provenance gates fail in a way that prevents causal interpretation.

gates: STANDARD exactly reproduces G23 pass/fail classification for all four frozen cases.
No participant status outside 0 occurs in these four G23 mixed-regime cases unless preserved as new scientific evidence.
Diagnostic G16 authority remains non-mutating in all 12 arms.
Every converged arm retains fixed XOLD, one prepare_time_step, one prepare_solve, exactly one finalize_solve and zero finalize_time_step.
Every converged arm passes the existing nominal final SWAP+ledger handoff.
No committed src/**, production MODFLOW configuration or production coupling policy changes.
next_if_supported: Translate the measured compatibility into a dimensionally explicit solver-versus-coupling stopping-criterion contract before considering any production configuration experiment. Do not select a tighter production dvclose directly from G24.
